next_60_days: Follow the cash ledger: Best Buy by Dec 27, Chase Freedom on Dec 31, PayPal by Jan 4, Chase Freedom Unlimited on Jan 29.
Call Credit Union of Texas: when the HELOC draw period ends, whether paid-down principal can be redrawn, and whether the interest is deductible.
Find PayPal's deferred-interest amount on the statement (it is not on file).
Ask Schwab whether the 5% match and the $250 kicker apply to the bonus; the 2028 match of $15,250 assumes they do.
Use Mom's $15,000 for the Dec 31 property tax.
Elect 5% 401(k) and about $46 HSA per check for 2027; name beneficiaries.
Submit a new W-4 in Workday: Single, Step 4(b) deductions $15,000, everything else blank. Set Step 4(b) back to $0 in January 2028.
Shop the car: $800 to $900 with Texas tax, 36 months, $0 down, 15,000 miles, or buy at $50,000.
Enroll in the Amex credits that need it (Resy, digital entertainment, Gold dining, lululemon) and add both cards to Uber.
Cancel flagged subscriptions; Sonic; electricity plan; State Farm quote; IRS transcripts; TWC appeal.
September 2027: check that BofA is under $1,000 and pay it off in early October. Line up a 0% transfer only if much more is left.
risks: Amex bills run $700 a month above plan: pause the $500 savings transfer first; BofA would not be cleared in October (each $700 a month leaves about $5,000 more for a 0% card).
First paycheck later than Dec 4: Dad's line covers about $6,000 for two weeks.
Bonus below target: each 10% is about $4,300 net.
Trade-in below $8,000 or refund below $9,800: BofA would need a 0% card for what is left.
